description: Impeccable design detector: immediate-tier checks after Edit/Write on UI files, full-rule deep pass on Stop.

hooks.command: engine="$HOME/.impeccable/vaultdex/engine-0.1.15/impeccable"; case "${OSTYPE:-}" in msys*|cygwin*) engine="$engine.exe";; esac; if [ -x "$engine" ]; then "$engine" hook; fi
engine="$HOME/.impeccable/vaultdex/engine-0.1.15/impeccable"; case "${OSTYPE:-}" in msys*|cygwin*) engine="$engine.exe";; esac; if [ -x "$engine" ]; then "$engine" hook; fi

in=
[ -t 0 ] || in=$(cat)
cwd=$(printf '%s\n' "$in" | sed -n 's/.*"cwd" *: *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | sed 's#\\\\#/#g')
# Claude loads hooks once per session: SessionStart keeps the settings fingerprint before the fast-forward below can change the file, SubagentStart warns when the last fetched base differs.
sid=$(printf '%s\n' "$in" | sed -n 's/.*"session_id" *: *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
fp="${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/hooks-fingerprint/$sid"
case $in in
*'"SubagentStart"'*)
seen=$(cat "$fp" 2>/dev/null)
for ref in '@{upstream}' origin/HEAD; do now=$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" rev-parse -q --verify "$ref:.claude/settings.json" 2>/dev/null) && break; done
[ -z "$seen" ] || [ -z "$now" ] || [ "$now" = "$seen" ] || printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SubagentStart","additionalContext":"Hooks seit Session-Start geändert: Session neu starten"}}';;
*'"compact"'*) ;;
*'"SessionStart"'*) [ -z "$sid" ] || { mkdir -p "${fp%/*}" && git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" hash-object "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/settings.json" >"$fp"; } 2>/dev/null;;
esac
check() {
dir=$1
root=$(git -C "$dir" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)
[ -n "$root" ] || { [ -d "$dir/.vendor/workflow-kit" ] && printf '%s: %s\n' "$dir" 'Workflow Kit not checked: git did not find the project repository (is git on PATH?). From that directory run git submodule update --init .vendor/workflow-kit'; return 0; }
for ref in '@{upstream}' origin/HEAD; do
base=$(git -C "$root" rev-parse --verify -q --abbrev-ref "$ref" 2>/dev/null) || continue
git -C "$root" merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD "$base" 2>/dev/null || continue
n=$(git -C "$root" rev-list --count "HEAD..$base" 2>/dev/null)
[ "${n:-0}" -gt 0 ] || continue
[ -n "$(git -C "$root" status --porcelain --ignore-submodules 2>/dev/null)" ] || { rec=; [ -e "$root/.vendor/workflow-kit/.git" ] && git -C "$root/.vendor/workflow-kit" symbolic-ref -q HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1 && rec='-c submodule.recurse=false'; git -C "$root" -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null $rec merge --ff-only --quiet "$base" >/dev/null 2>&1; }
break
done
set -- $(git -C "$root" ls-files -s -- .vendor/workflow-kit 2>/dev/null)
[ "$1" = 160000 ] || return 0
pin=$2
kit="$root/.vendor/workflow-kit"
ok() { [ "$(git -C "$kit" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)" = "$pin" ] && [ -f "$kit/AGENT_RULES.md" ]; }
ok && return 0
gd=$(git -C "$root" rev-parse --absolute-git-dir 2>/dev/null) && rmdir "$gd/modules/.vendor/workflow-kit" "$gd/modules/.vendor" "$gd/modules" 2>/dev/null
if [ -f "$kit/.git" ] && ! git -C "$kit" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then
if [ "$(ls -A "$kit")" = .git ]; then rm -f "$kit/.git"; else printf '%s: %s\n' "$root" 'Workflow Kit has a .git that points nowhere and other files, so it was not repaired: if they are not needed, from that directory run rm -rf .vendor/workflow-kit && git submodule update --init .vendor/workflow-kit'; return 0; fi
fi
if [ -e "$kit/.git" ] && { [ -n "$(git -C "$kit" status --porcelain --ignored --untracked-files=all 2>/dev/null)" ] || [ -n "$(git -C "$kit" rev-list -n 1 HEAD --not --remotes 2>/dev/null)" ] || git -C "$kit" symbolic-ref -q HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1; }; then printf '%s: %s\n' "$root" 'Workflow Kit is not at the commit this project pins, but it has local changes, unpublished commits or a checked-out branch, so it was not updated: resolve them, then from that directory run git submodule update --init .vendor/workflow-kit'; return 0; fi
GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_ASKPASS=true SSH_ASKPASS=true git -C "$root" -c credential.interactive=false -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null submodule update --init --checkout .vendor/workflow-kit >/dev/null 2>&1
ok || printf '%s: %s\n' "$root" 'Workflow Kit missing, incomplete or not at the commit this project pins: from that directory run git submodule update --init .vendor/workflow-kit (still missing: git -C .vendor/workflow-kit checkout -- AGENT_RULES.md)'
}
# A subagent in its own worktree gets CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR of the session that started it; its own directory is the cwd on stdin.
check "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"
[ -z "$cwd" ] || [ "$cwd" = "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" ] || check "$cwd"
exit 0

dir=${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}
root=$(git -C "$dir" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0
for ref in '@{upstream}' origin/HEAD; do
base=$(git -C "$root" rev-parse --verify -q --abbrev-ref "$ref" 2>/dev/null) || continue
git -C "$root" merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD "$base" 2>/dev/null || continue
n=$(git -C "$root" rev-list --count "HEAD..$base" 2>/dev/null)
[ "${n:-0}" -gt 0 ] || continue
[ -n "$(git -C "$root" --no-optional-locks status --porcelain --ignore-submodules 2>/dev/null)" ] || continue
base=$(printf %s "$base" | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9/._-')
msg="Checkout is $n commit(s) behind $base (as of the last fetch) and has no commits of its own but local changes, so it was not fast-forwarded and its rules, skills and board commands may be outdated. Nothing was fetched: commit or stash the changes, run git fetch, then git merge --ff-only $base; skills load at session start, so restart after updating."
printf '%s\n' "$msg"
exit 0
done
exit 0

dir=${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}
root=$(git -C "$dir" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0
[ -d "$root/node_modules" ] && exit 0
tr -d ' \n\r\t' < "$root/package.json" 2>/dev/null | grep -Eq '"(dev[Dd]|d)ependencies":\{"' || exit 0
setup=$(tr -d '\n\r' < "$root/.github/workflow-project.json" 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.*"setup" *: *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9 /._:=@-')
msg="node_modules is missing in this worktree although package.json lists dependencies, so Node may resolve modules from a parent checkout. Nothing was installed: run ${setup:-the project setup (see its AGENTS.md)}."
printf '%s\n' "$msg"

launcher="$HOME/.ponytail/vaultdex/5.2.0-1/launch.sh"; if [ -f "$launcher" ]; then /bin/sh "$launcher" activate claude; else printf '%s\n' 'Ponytail hooks missing: run git submodule update --init --recursive .vendor/workflow-kit, then node .vendor/workflow-kit/scripts/install-ponytail-hooks.mjs and trust the hooks.'; fi

engine="$HOME/.impeccable/vaultdex/engine-0.1.15/impeccable"; case "${OSTYPE:-}" in msys*|cygwin*) engine="$engine.exe";; esac; if [ ! -x "$engine" ]; then printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"Impeccable hooks missing, UI checks are off: run git submodule update --init --recursive .vendor/workflow-kit, then node .vendor/workflow-kit/scripts/install-impeccable-hooks.mjs and trust the hooks.","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"Impeccable hooks missing, UI checks are off: run git submodule update --init --recursive .vendor/workflow-kit, then node .vendor/workflow-kit/scripts/install-impeccable-hooks.mjs and trust the hooks."}}'; fi

launcher="$HOME/.ponytail/vaultdex/5.2.0-1/launch.sh"; if [ -f "$launcher" ]; then /bin/sh "$launcher" activate claude continue; else printf '%s\n' 'Ponytail hooks missing: run git submodule update --init --recursive .vendor/workflow-kit, then node .vendor/workflow-kit/scripts/install-ponytail-hooks.mjs and trust the hooks.'; fi
